competing_hypotheses.claim: The decline in aggregate Hidden Road customer DCO cash margins and required segregation from October 16 to October 28 reflects changing aggregate FCM customer futures exposures/positions/margin requirements; it is not evidence of XRP selling or XRP collateral withdrawal.
counter_evidence: The series is incomplete and does not provide contract-level/product-level positions.
Changes in margin may result from price, mix, options, settlement and rule changes.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The roughly $65.4–$65.6M excess segregated funds reported on October 20, 27 and 28 are customer segregation buffers above required funds, not proprietary free cash, XRP buying capacity or an investable reserve.
counter_evidence: The FCM's management target is $27.3M, but excess above target remains within the customer segregation framework and cannot be treated as free firm capital.
